verdict.rationale: Skills are plain folders: a SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter and markdown instructions, plus optional scripts/, references/ and assets/ directories. A runtime probe installed one skill into ./.claude/skills/ as copied files and read the SKILL.md back cleanly, so every installed file can be inspected afterward. Before installing, the only evidenced route is browsing the public GitHub repo; no documented install flow or command lists a skill's or plugin's files and scripts for review. Missing for 10: a documented pre-install content listing or preview for plugin/marketplace installs, a first-party review/audit workflow for bundled scripts, and independent corroboration of the review process.
